title: Canadian contract SRE, Platform & DevOps opportunities
lede: Six independent portal searches with full-page validation and regional gating.
latest_update: October 7, 2026 — all six searches completed; 30 query cards reviewed, 13 unique plausible postings, no new qualifying filing.

rows.title: Senior Salesforce DevOps Engineer – AI Automation
rows.gap: Asks 4–8 years AI experience; otherwise Salesforce, Azure, CI/CD, gated AI automation and influence-without-authority align closely.

rows.title: Cloud Security DevSecOps Engineer (Azure Focus)
rows.gap: Azure Defender/IAM/security-pattern ownership is deeper than Marc's security engineering evidence; posting is closed.

rows.title: Senior Azure Cloud DevOps Specialist
rows.gap: Secret/CGP/Trade Controlled clearance is required; rate is below the long-term comfortable target and office cadence is high.

rows.title: Cloud Security DevSecOps Engineer (AWS Focus)
rows.location: Toronto — contradictory Remote / 5 days in office
rows.gap: Posting is closed and states five Toronto office days despite the remote card; deep AWS security requirement is also a hard gap.

rows.title: Senior Applied Intelligence Platform Engineer
rows.gap: Toronto hybrid is outside the reachable-city range; role is MLOps/LLMOps and AI-governance centered.

rows.title: Senior Performance Engineer
rows.gap: Texas on-site and US work authorization restriction exclude Canada.

rows.title: Platform & Integration Software Engineer
rows.gap: Intermediate API/data-contract integration engineering for document processing, not platform infrastructure.

rows.title: Senior Software Engineer
rows.gap: MuleSoft API and ETL/ELT application development rather than DevOps; rate also tops out at the short-contract floor.

rows.title: AI Software Engineer
rows.gap: AI application development, and the US on-site requirement excludes Canada.

rows.title: Senior Python/SQL Engineer - Risk Division
rows.gap: Database/application migration to Snowflake, not platform engineering; Toronto hybrid is ineligible.

notes_sections.heading: Query audit
items: Platform Engineer: 14 results, first 8 reviewed — Complete.
Site Reliability Engineer: 1 result, reviewed — Complete.
Cloud Engineer: 16 results, first 8 reviewed — Complete.
DevSecOps Engineer: 2 results, both reviewed — Complete.
No CAPTCHA or verification prompt appeared.

method: All six Procom portal queries were rendered independently. Card metadata was captured before deduplication, and every plausible or ambiguous result within the review cap was opened in full. No new posting met filing rules; known pipeline decisions were preserved.
